S24.02.needs: a signed-in account with at least one uploaded file
steps: Sign in and open the menu with the button at the top left.
Tap Library.
Tap the chip Uploads in the row under the Library title.
Compare the grid with Expected: only files you uploaded should appear, and no generated files.
S24.02.where: Menu (button at top left) > Library > Uploads

S24.03.needs: a signed-in account with at least one generated file
steps: Sign in and open the menu with the button at the top left.
Tap Library.
Tap the chip Generated files in the row under the Library title.
Compare the grid with Expected: only files the assistant generated should appear.
S24.03.where: Menu (button at top left) > Library > Generated files

S24.04.needs: a signed-in account with at least one artifact
S24.04.note: Artifacts shown are filtered to the current app mode (Cloud or Local), so an artifact made in the other mode will not appear.
steps: Sign in and open the menu with the button at the top left.
Tap Library.
Tap the chip Artifacts in the row under the Library title.
Tap one artifact card.
Compare with Expected: the list should show your artifacts and the tapped one should open in the Artifacts screen.
S24.04.where: Menu (button at top left) > Library > Artifacts

S24.05.needs: a signed-in account with at least one image
steps: Sign in and open the menu with the button at the top left.
Tap Library.
Tap the chip Images in the row under the Library title.
Tap one image card.
Compare with Expected: the Images view should list your images and the tapped image should open full screen in a viewer.
S24.05.where: Menu (button at top left) > Library > Images

S24.06.needs: a signed-in account with at least one video
steps: Sign in and open the menu with the button at the top left.
Tap Library.
Tap the chip Videos in the row under the Library title.
Tap one video card.
Compare with Expected: the video should open in a player and play.
S24.06.where: Menu (button at top left) > Library > Videos

S24.08.needs: a signed-in account with several files
S24.08.note: There is no separate recent-files view. The sort is labelled Recently added and maps to the modified sort key, so it is not based on when a file was last used.
steps: Sign in and tap Library in the menu.
Tap the ... button at the top right (Library options).
Tap Sort saved files, then Recently added.
Compare with Expected: the newest files should be at the top of the grid.
S24.08.where: Library > Library options (the ... button at top right) > Sort saved files > Recently added

S24.13.needs: a signed-in account with several named files
steps: Sign in and tap Library in the menu.
Tap the search field at the bottom that says Search library.
Type part of a file name you know exists.
Compare with Expected: the grid should narrow to files whose name matches.
S24.13.where: Library > search field at the bottom labelled Search library

S24.14.needs: a signed-in account with files of more than one type
steps: Sign in and tap Library in the menu.
Swipe the chip row sideways to reach the chips.
Tap Documents, then Images, then Videos.
Compare with Expected: the grid should show only the chosen file type each time.
S24.14.where: Library > filter chips row under the Library title: Images, Videos, Documents, Code, Charts, Research

S24.28.needs: a signed-in account with a document file
S24.28.note: The Add to chat option is not offered for videos, and only appears in Cloud mode.
steps: Sign in and tap Library in the menu.
Press and hold a document card (not a video).
Tap Add to chat in the menu that opens with the file name as title.
Compare with Expected: the app should open the chat screen with the file attached in the message box.
S24.28.where: Library > long press a file card > Add to chat

S24.33.note: The line only appears when the server returns storage numbers, and it is hidden inside Recently deleted.
steps: Sign in and tap Library in the menu. Look just under the filter chips for a line ending in file storage used.
Compare the amount used with the limit shown in that line.
Open the menu, tap Settings, then tap Storage.
Compare with Expected: the storage breakdown should show how much your files use against the allowance.
S24.33.where: Library > top of the file grid (text ending in file storage used); and Settings > Storage

S24.34.needs: a signed-in account with at least one file
S24.34.note: The Recently deleted screen says files are erased after 30 days, and Delete permanently is also offered there.
steps: Sign in, tap Library in the menu, then long press a file card and tap Delete.
Tap Delete on the Delete from Library? dialog.
Tap Library options (... at top right), then Recently deleted.
Long press the file, tap Restore, then go back to Library and check the file is back in the grid.
S24.34.where: Library > Library options (... at top right) > Recently deleted; to delete: long press a file > Delete
